name: Route test-only beads to haiku by default
hypothesis: Beads detected by IsTestOnlyBead() are lower complexity since they only add/modify test files. Routing them to haiku will reduce their average cost from ~$0.60 (sonnet) to ~$0.08 (haiku) without significantly increasing failure rate, because the escalation chain provides a safety net.
change: In Runner.selectModel(), when bead.IsTestOnlyBead(b.Title) returns true and no explicit complexity label is set, return haiku instead of the priority-based model. Explicit labels still override.
measurement: Compare success rate and average cost of test-only beads before vs after. Target: maintain >80% success rate while reducing average cost by >50%. Track how many test-only beads require escalation to sonnet/opus.
risk: Some test-only beads may be more complex than the title suggests (e.g., tests requiring complex fixture setup or touching integration boundaries). These would fail on haiku and require escalation, potentially increasing total cost if the escalation chain adds iterations.
